text: Done in 236550f. fixIntent maps findings to one correctable document: MriRepetitionTimeMismatch -> run sidecar (stem+.json, added or merged) with RepetitionTime = recorded temporalSpacingSeconds and the authored value stated; any finding whose own path is a correctable doc (json, events/beh tsv, bval/bvec) -> correct it with 'row N' positions flagged; LimitExceeded, EventsImage*, EventsVolumeCount, EventsTimingUnavailable, CompanionUnsupported/Missing and image-only findings -> no Fix (open file). Unknown codes fall back to open-only. Probes: fix-offered-where-editable, fix-tr-suggests-sidecar, fix-events-selects-row. check-console.sh 75/75; check-console-backend.sh PASS.
